# Cyber Threat Intelligence Report

> Independent OSINT-based cyber threat intelligence (CTI) archive by Dennis Kim (김호광 / HoKwang Kim), CEO of Betalabs Inc. and former CEO of Cyworld Z. Multilingual (KR/EN/JP/ZH) reports covering supply chain attacks, zero-day vulnerabilities, DPRK/state-sponsored APT (Lazarus, Kimsuky, ScarCruft, Andariel), AI/LLM threats, Web3/crypto security, and Korean breach/policy cases. All content TLP:GREEN for defensive, research, and policy purposes.

## Coverage Areas

- **Supply Chain Attacks**: Miasma/Spring Blight Azure infection, IronWorm, GlassWorm self-propagating worm, Claude Code GitHub Action, WebSphere CVEs, Gitea/Gogs Git server vulnerabilities, Vercel AI SaaS supply chain, DualThreat (LiteSpeed/Shai-Hulud), GitHub internal repo compromise, AI supply-chain threats, SWIFTVIBE agentic AI
- **Zero-Day & Vulnerabilities**: KNDA diplomat system zero-day, Microsoft Patch Tuesday (206 CVEs), AI-generated zero-day exploits, Citrix NetScaler memory overread, Mirai botnet zero-day, YellowKey BitLocker bypass, Drupal core max-severity, Exchange Server, CopyFail (CVE-2026-31431), Coruna iOS Exploit Kit, Android EoP
- **DPRK & State-Sponsored APT**: DPRK AI-enabled hacking qualitative shift, Kimsuky (APT43) PebbleDash/AppleSeed, Kimsuky LNK/Dropbox, Lazarus git-hooks concealment, Lazarus macOS ClickFix, ScarCruft (APT37), DPRK hacking trends 2026, AICYBER DPRK LLM hacking, Iran GenAI in warfare, UNC6508 RedCap, Scattered Spider, GREYVIBE GenAI Ukraine operation, PRC influence operations
- **AI/LLM Threats**: SWIFTVIBE agentic AI cloud intrusion, AI-generated zero-day exploits, Claude Code supply-chain vulnerability, DPRK AI hacking, GREYVIBE GenAI operations, ChatGPhish ChatGPT impersonation phishing, AI cryptojacking, EvilTokens AI device-code phishing, AICYBER agentic defense, VIBE age of AI hacking, MCP intelligent/sleeper attacks, AI supply-chain threats
- **Web3 & Crypto**: Ostium oracle-manipulation exploit ($11.86M–$23.7M, Arbitrum), Bonzo Finance oracle exploit ($9.05M, Hedera), KelpDAO DeFi threat, AI cryptojacking, UK Russia crypto sanctions, Litecoin vulnerability, Kakao Style ZigZag
- **Korea Cybersecurity & Breaches**: KNDA diplomat system long-term intrusion, IITP personal-data access-log breach, LY LINE Yahoo LINE GAME internal-ID transmission, New Jistock PII breach (MTTD 127 days), Tving personal data breach, CU convenience-store delivery data breach, FastCampus/DayOne GitHub master-key theft, Kakao Style ZigZag hack, ModooSign breach, Qishing (QR code phishing), GitHub key leak incidents, Korea weekly CTI briefings
- **Weekly Briefings**: Weekly cyber threat intelligence briefings (KR/EN) covering emerging threats, new CVEs, APT campaigns, and Korea-specific incidents
